text: I need three separate, matching still ads for a plant shop in 1:1, 9:16 and 16:9. Include exactly: “Fern House”, “Weekend Plant Sale”, “20% off all indoor plants”, “Saturday & Sunday”, “Visit 24 Willow Lane”. Use leafy plants and a clean green-and-cream look, consistent across the set. Keep every line easy to read in all three, especially the address—rearrange things instead of shrinking the whole design. The specific plants, fonts and layout are your call, and use Saturday & Sunday as written without calendar dates. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so tell me what this will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter or smaller way to do it?
